title: CONTRACT-ACT-1 — ClinicalAct discriminated union (Proposed; for cdss-spine ratification on DEC-02 + DEC-09)
$comment: Companion to 05_registers-and-contracts/CONTRACT-ACT-1_act_schema.md. Six act kinds: signoff (HA-1), deviation (HA-2), gap_report (HA-3), fit_judgment (HA-4), conflict_navigation (HA-5), boundary_work (HA-6). Each produces exactly one append-only fabric entry (SPINE-4). Discriminated on 'kind'. CONTRACT-DEV-1 (the standalone Deviation object, SPINE-8) is retained; this contract is the six-act envelope. severity_tier vocabulary is [NEEDS DEFINITION — DEC-02]; pattern only. Breaking-change rule: Arch §10 — a change to this file is a spine PR that visibly breaks consumers. Built 2026-09-09 (sprint-mak66, TASK-HDC-002 / MAK-66).

ActorIdentity.title: ActorIdentity — attributed actor with authority class (ACT-2)

actor_id.description: Attributed identity of the acting clinician. Not an authentication token; endpoint enforces authority.

authority_class.description: 'recording' suffices for deviation, gap_report, fit_judgment, conflict_navigation, boundary_work. 'clinical-release' required for signoff only.

FabricEntryRef.title: FabricEntryRef — reference to the append-only fabric entry (SPINE-4)
FabricEntryRef.$comment: Full chain protocol owned by cdss-fabric; GAP-ACT-003.

entry_id.description: Stable identifier of the fabric entry (SPINE-4)

entry_hash.description: Hash of the entry content for chain verification (SPINE-4)

ProjectionContext.title: ProjectionContext — artifact versions determining the rendered state at sign-off (ACT-11; SPINE-5)
ProjectionContext.$comment: An argument version pin alone does not constitute sufficient replay evidence. All version fields are required except codebook_version.

projection_version.description: R1 pin for the SPINE-9 clinical projection the actor saw

codebook_version.description: Codebook version — present when codebook vocabulary was in use at sign-off

layout_config_hash.description: Hash of the layout/configuration in effect at sign-off

GapLocus.title: GapLocus — discriminated locus for gap_report (ACT-7)
GapLocus.$comment: Exactly one locus_kind applies. arg_id locus: released argument contextualizes the gap. template locus: GenericArgument template. encounter locus: encounter + screen. element locus: specific UI element.

arg_id.description: Released ActualArgument that contextualizes the gap

FitJudgmentBasis.title: FitJudgmentBasis — structured basis for fit_judgment (ACT-8; MS-7)

mismatch_description.description: Description of the out-of-envelope mismatch that triggered the flagged verdict

clinical_grounds.description: Clinician's stated clinical grounds for the judgment

decision.description: The judgment decision — whether to proceed past the flagged verdict

AuthorStance.title: AuthorStance — per-author position in conflict_navigation (ACT-12; HT-3)

author_id.description: Identity of the author holding this position

position.description: The author's stated position on the conflict

reasoning.description: The author's reasoning supporting their position

BoundaryContext.title: BoundaryContext — threshold reference and distance (HA-2; FC-2)

threshold_ref.description: Reference to the ratified threshold relevant to this boundary

distance.description: Distance to the threshold — a string to avoid encoding clinical numbers in this schema

SignoffAct.title: SignoffAct — fail-closed human sign-off attributed to argument version (HA-1; REG-KEEP-003)
SignoffAct.$comment: Invariant: absent a SignoffAct, no release-class action exists for the encounter, regardless of elapsed time, inactivity, focus loss, or navigation (HDC8 property 6). actor.authority_class MUST be clinical-release.

arg_version.description: Version of the argument at sign-off (SPINE-5 pin)

verdict_ref.description: The verdict record this sign-off acts on (RG-2)

DeviationAct.title: DeviationAct — structured departure from a recommendation (HA-2; SPINE-8)
DeviationAct.$comment: free_text is never blocked. severity_tier vocabulary is [NEEDS DEFINITION — DEC-02]; pattern only. boundary_context auto-attached on borderline flag (FC-2). Coexists with GapReportAct on the same encounter (HA-3).

arg_version.description: Version of the argument at the time of deviation (SPINE-5)

verdict_ref.description: The verdict record this deviation applies to (RG-2; optional)

reason_taxonomy_code.description: Structured reason code from the ratified deviation taxonomy (OPS-1 change class: deviation-taxonomy; lives in the registry)

severity_tier.description: [NEEDS DEFINITION — architecture owner, DEC-02] tier vocabulary not yet ratified; pattern only (carried from CONTRACT-DEV-1)

free_text.description: Clinician's stated reason in their own words — never blocked or validated away (HA-2)

GapReportAct.title: GapReportAct — missing recommendation, available from any screen (HA-3; MS-2)
GapReportAct.$comment: No released ActualArgument required. locus is required; arg_id/arg_version are optional (present when a released argument contextualizes the gap). Coexists with DeviationAct on the same encounter (HA-3).

locus.description: Discriminated locus — where on the screen or argument this gap was observed

arg_id.description: Optional: released ActualArgument contextualizing the gap, when available

FitJudgmentAct.title: FitJudgmentAct — human judgment on a flagged out-of-envelope verdict (HA-4; MS-7)
FitJudgmentAct.$comment: Only path through which a flagged verdict may proceed (HDC8 property 3). verdict_ref must reference a flagged verdict (RG-2 flagged class); the schema cannot enforce this at the JSON level — runtime enforcement is the implementation's responsibility.

arg_id.description: The ActualArgument whose verdict is flagged (CONTRACT-ARG-1)

arg_version.description: Version of the argument at fit-judgment time (SPINE-5)

verdict_ref.description: The flagged verdict this fit-judgment acts on (RG-2 flagged class)

basis.description: Structured basis for the judgment (ACT-8; MS-7)

ConflictNavigationAct.title: ConflictNavigationAct — recorded meta-rational navigation of co-applicable conflicts (HA-5; MS-7)
ConflictNavigationAct.$comment: choice + reasons + residue required. author_stances carry per-author positions in team mode; dissent is preserved, not averaged (ACT-12; HDC8 property 10). arg_ids order carries no preference semantics.

conflict_record_ref.description: Reference to the ConflictRecord materialized at stage 4 (MAK-CEC RG-2; SPINE-6/MS-5)

choice.description: Which path was chosen in navigating the conflict

reasons.description: Clinician's stated reasons for the choice

residue.description: Unresolved aspects of the conflict preserved verbatim — never discarded

arg_ids.description: Co-applicable argument IDs in conflict — order carries no preference semantics

author_stances.description: Per-author stances in team mode (ACT-12; HT-3). Required when multi-author context applies.

BoundaryWorkAct.title: BoundaryWorkAct — verbatim clinician text preserved without validation gate (HA-6; MS-3)
BoundaryWorkAct.$comment: verbatim_text is never blocked, truncated, or silently rewritten. Display escaping is applied at the rendering layer, not here. display_safe_text is optional; its absence does not suppress verbatim_text.

verbatim_text.description: Clinician's authored text preserved exactly as written — no validation gate (HA-6; MS-3)

boundary_context.description: Optional: threshold and distance context if relevant

display_safe_text.description: Optional: safely escaped version for rendering — absence does not suppress verbatim_text
